name: james-watson-gauntlet-loop
description: Public design contracts for a constraint-led prompt compiler and agent-project orchestration control plane; no executable application or private compiler constitution is included.

metadata.github_description: The James Watson Gauntlet Loop is a recursive multi-agent framework forcing AI systems to challenge assumptions, evidence, beliefs, and more. Built to move beyond linear prompting toward self-correcting agentic intelligence, it explores practical paths towards the next frontier of AGI.

deep_review.conclusion: Review is limited to public design evidence. All runtime and privacy protections are proposed architecture, not implemented controls. The documents specify keeping private compiler configuration on a protected server and out of generated prompts, logs and execution repositories. That private material is absent from this tree and was neither requested nor inspected. No license grant is present, so assets are catalogued as references rather than assumed redistributable implementations.
